beats.name: Cold reveal
beats.purpose: Name the actor and the impossible-sounding achievement in one sentence. The full claim lands in the first line. No greeting, no self-introduction, no teasing, no stating what the video will cover.

beats.name: Pivot to how
beats.purpose: A short turn from what happened to how it actually works. This is the promise that keeps the viewer past five seconds.

beats.name: Mechanism
beats.purpose: The technical explanation in three or four concrete steps, naming specific components, models or parts. This is the bulk of the video and the actual content.

beats.name: Escalation
beats.purpose: One further layer that raises the stakes. The detail that is more surprising than the main claim itself.

beats.name: Hard numbers
beats.purpose: Specific figures. Price, specs, scale, money, dates. Credibility ballast.

beats.name: Zoom out
beats.purpose: One line of significance at industry or category level. Never about the product itself.

beats.name: Sign-off
beats.purpose: Under five words, or a single short question back to the viewer.

rules: Never introduce yourself or greet the viewer
Never state what the video is about or what it will cover, just start
Every claim carries a named entity or a specific number
The how is the content, the what is only the hook
No filler transitions like so basically, let me explain, or imagine this
Total must be close to 150 words, never more
